name: grapple_swing
chapter: Core mechanics: grapple target, attach, jump into the gap with the rope, the driven swing, climb / slide on the rope with Interact, jump off, landing
note: l3_chapel: ceiling ring 4744 from the column top (GameReal.ChapelRingFromTheColumnTop). g_grapple data [O]: throw range and longest rope 4424.78, shortest 553.1. Rope inputs and the swing law are tru.exe's (docs/GAMEPLAY.md Grapple: 0x746F60, player data +0x9C8..+0xA54).

re-measured under the move stick filter (0x483520, StickRateFilter): 3893.7 (4422.2 before, min 4000): the earlier steps' keys land a frame late, so Forward meets the swing at another phase; the bound keeps its margin (min / measured 0.90)

Interact + forward: 23.70 per 30 Hz frame = 711.1 units/s [O +0x9E4], for 59 of the step's 60 ticks: the stick's forward lands a tick late through the move stick filter (0x483520) while Interact acts at once, 711.1 - 11.85. Measured 699.27 with the filter, 711.12 without it. The rope's change, not its absolute length, which depends on where the slide and settle left it
